verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an incident management platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only describes Rootly as a hosted SaaS (sign-up, organization settings, hosted API keys) and never mentions a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of the core product. The MCP server is an integration, not the core product, so it does not count here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
